register.description: This register is used to configure SRAM and VIMS watermark. This register is protected by odd parity bits.

bitfield.description: Parity bits. Bit 29 stores the odd parity for bits 0 to 7. Bit 30 stores the odd parity of bits 8 to 15. Bit 31 stores the odd parity of bits 23 to 16. PAR[29] = ~XOR(VIMSWM[7:0]) PAR[30] = ~XOR({[VIMSWM[9:8]], SRAMWM[15:12]}) PAR[31] = ~XOR(SRAMWM[21:16])
Software should not rely on the value of a reserved. Writing any other value than the reset value may result in undefined behavior.

SRAM Watermark. The address from (SRAM Base Address) to (SRAM Base Address + (SRAMWM + 1)$lt;$lt;10 - 1) is considered secure. The address from (SRAM Base Address + (SRAMWM + 1) $lt;$lt;10) to (SRAM Last Address) is considered Non-secure.
Software should not rely on the value of a reserved. Writing any other value than the reset value may result in undefined behavior.

VIMS Watermark The address from (Flash Main Base Address) to (Flash Main Base Address + (VIMSWM + 1)$lt;$lt;13 - 1) is considered secure. The address from (Flash Main Base Address + (VIMSWM + 1)$lt;$lt;13) to (Flash Main Last Address) is considered Non-secure.

register.description: This register is used to store gasket configuration. This register is protected by odd parity bits.

bitfield.description: Parity bits. Bit 29 stores the odd parity for bits 0 to 7. Bit 30 stores the odd parity of bits 8 to 15. Bit 31 stores the odd parity of bits 23 to 16. PAR[29] = ~XOR(GSKEN0[7:0]) PAR[30] = ~XOR(GSKEN0[15:8]) PAR[31] = ~XOR(GSKEN0[23:16])
